meta.source_layer: WotLK base tables from the supplied Questie package; Titan effective resolver is still a separate pending layer
meta.analysis: threshold-free point-cloud geometry; no nearby/overlap classification is hard-coded yet

metric_notes.centroid_distance: distance between mean centers in Questie map percentage units
metric_notes.symmetric_nn_p50: mean of both directed median nearest-neighbor distances; lower means the two clouds interleave more strongly
metric_notes.symmetric_nn_p90: same idea at p90; lower means most of both clouds remain near each other
metric_notes.bbox_iou: axis-aligned bounding-box overlap only; diagnostic, not final overlap truth
metric_notes.axis_strength: PCA anisotropy in [0,1]; higher means the cloud has a clearer elongation direction
